fullPassage: Among unsatisfied professionals, there's a repeating theme — the belief that someday (a mysterious day in the future) things will miraculously change and they'll stumble into the perfect job or career. At the same time, they (typically) do little to meaningfully alter their current situation. They don't like their job, so what do they do? They head to job boards and search for roles with a similar job title, hoping that the universe will sprinkle a bit of magic on their career if they just hit the refresh button in a different department or company. Efforts like this make professionals feel like they are doing something, when really they're just setting themselves up to take a new role and quickly become just as disenchanted as they were before. It's like rearranging deck chairs on the Titanic. You've got to completely switch up your approach. If you keep playing the same game, you'll win the same prizes.

✅ ① (A) switch up your approach = 접근법(명사), (B) the deadline begins to approach = 다가오다(동사) ←정답
❌ ② (A)는 '다가오다'가 아니라 바꿔야 할 '접근법'
❌ ③ (B)는 '접근법'이 아니라 마감이 '다가오다'
❌ ④ (A)는 '다가오다'가 아니라 명사 '접근법'
det.tip: approach: 접근법(명사) / 다가오다, 다가가다(동사). 문맥으로 품사와 의미를 구별

questions.stem: 다음 영영 정의에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은? "difficult to understand, explain, or identify"

det.analysis:
❌ ① obvious(명백한) — 이해하기 어렵다는 정의와 반대
❌ ② ordinary(평범한) — 특이함과 무관
❌ ③ similar(비슷한) — 유사성을 뜻해 무관
✅ ④ mysterious(불가사의한) — 이해·설명·식별이 어려운, 즉 불가사의한 ←정답
det.tip: mysterious = 이해하거나 설명하기 어려운, 불가사의한

questions.passage: Among unsatisfied professionals, there's a repeating theme — the __________ (believe) that someday things will miraculously change. At the same time, they do little to meaningfully alter their current situation.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (1단어, 영어로)

det.analysis: believe(동사) → belief(명사): 관사 the의 수식을 받는 명사 자리이므로 동사 believe를 명사 belief로 바꾼다. the belief that ...은 '...라는 믿음'이라는 동격 구문이다.
det.tip: 동사 → 명사: believe → belief

questions.passage: Among unsatisfied professionals, there's a belief that someday things will __________ (miracle) change and they'll stumble into the perfect job or career.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (1단어, 영어로)

det.analysis: miracle(명사) → miraculous(형용사) → miraculously(부사): 동사 change를 수식하는 부사 자리이므로 명사 miracle을 부사 miraculously로 바꾼다. things will miraculously change는 '상황이 기적적으로 변할 것'이라는 뜻이다.
det.tip: 명사 → 부사: miracle → miraculously

questions.passage: Among unsatisfied professionals, there's a repeating theme — the belief that someday (a mysterious day in the future) things will miraculously change and they'll stumble into the perfect job or career. At the same time, they (typically) do little to meaningfully alter their current situation. They don't like their job, so what do they do? They head to job boards and search for roles with a similar job title, hoping that the universe will sprinkle a bit of magic on their career if they just hit the refresh button in a different department or company. Efforts like this make professionals feel like they are doing something, when really they're just setting themselves up to take a new role and quickly become just as disenchanted as they were before. It's like rearranging deck chairs on the Titanic. You've got to completely __________ your approach. If you keep playing the same game, you'll win the same prizes.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:
❌ ① hold onto(고수하다) — 접근법을 바꾸라는 주장과 반대
❌ ② give up(포기하다) — 접근법을 포기하라는 게 아니라 바꾸라는 것
✅ ③ switch up(완전히 바꾸다) — 접근 방식을 완전히 바꿔야 함 ←정답
❌ ④ care for(돌보다) — 돌봄의 의미로 문맥 부적합
det.tip: completely switch up your approach: 접근 방식을 완전히 바꾸다

questions.passage: Among unsatisfied professionals, there's a repeating theme — the belief that someday (a mysterious day in the future) things will miraculously change and they'll __________ the perfect job or career. At the same time, they (typically) do little to meaningfully alter their current situation. They don't like their job, so what do they do? They head to job boards and search for roles with a similar job title, hoping that the universe will sprinkle a bit of magic on their career if they just hit the refresh button in a different department or company. Efforts like this make professionals feel like they are doing something, when really they're just setting themselves up to take a new role and quickly become just as disenchanted as they were before. It's like rearranging deck chairs on the Titanic. You've got to completely switch up your approach. If you keep playing the same game, you'll win the same prizes.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 언젠가 완벽한 직장이나 경력을 우연히 '마주치게(stumble into)' 될 거라는 믿음
det.analysis:
❌ ① hold back from(~을 삼가다) — 완벽한 직장을 피한다는 뜻이 되어 모순
❌ ② give rise to(~을 일으키다) — 직장을 만들어낸다는 뜻으로 문맥 부적합
❌ ③ do away with(~을 없애다) — 직장을 없앤다는 뜻으로 모순
✅ ④ stumble into(우연히 마주치다) — 언젠가 완벽한 직장을 우연히 만나게 될 거라는 믿음 ←정답
det.tip: stumble into the perfect job: 완벽한 직장을 우연히 만나다
